items.t: AGNC Yields About 18%, and Main Street Capital about 6%. Only 1 of Them Covered Its Dividend With Room to Spare.
items.sum: Too much of a good thing can result in bad outcomes when you are a dividend investor.

items.t: Trinity Capital: Sell-Off Has Created A Better Entry, But Premium Still Too Wide Here
items.sum: Trinity Capital's Q3 investment income rose 30% year over year, while non-accruals and payment-in-kind income remained below 1%. But I rate TRIN stock as Hold.

items.t: 4 High-Yield Dividend Stocks That Could Help Retirees Stay Ahead of Inflation
items.sum: Prices keep climbing, and a flat dividend quietly shrinks your buying power every year. Four income payers, from a landlord to a tobacco giant, each rely on a different built-in defense, but one of them still trails inflation.

items.t: If the Fed Hikes on Dec. 9, These 4 Dividend Stocks Are Built to Handle It
items.sum: Traders see a December rate rise as nearly certain, and it will separate dividends funded by surplus cash from those propped up by cheap debt. Which payouts, from pipelines to a Dividend King, look ready for the test?

items.t: BIZD Over PBDC: The Index Is The Better BDC Buy For 2027
items.sum: BIZD over PBDC? Each BDC offers something different for investors looking for income.

items.t: CION Investment's Non-Accrual Loans Rise in Q3: Is Credit Risk Rising?
items.sum: CION's non-accrual ratios rise in Q3, but portfolio contraction explains much of the increase. Higher debt levels and weaker interest coverage still warrant caution.
